title: Tower Claims Synthetic Event Schema
description: Schema for synthetic Tower Insurance NZ claims events emitted by the Fabric Real-Time Intelligence demo. This schema documents synthetic demo data only and is not based on real Tower customer records.

customer_id.description: Synthetic customer identifier; not real personal information.

event_id.description: Unique event identifier for the emitted message.

event_sequence.description: Monotonic sequence number generated by the notebook session.

product.description: Insurance product associated with the claim.

claim_type.description: Synthetic claim cause/type aligned to the selected product.

lodgement_channel.description: Channel through which the synthetic claim was lodged.

region.description: Synthetic New Zealand region, weighted toward Auckland during the severe-weather spike.

suburb.description: Synthetic suburb/locality within the selected region.

supplier.description: Synthetic supplier assigned to assessment, repair, or settled claims.

assessor.description: Synthetic assessor name used for demo workload analysis.

weather_event_id.description: Synthetic weather event identifier for weather-related claims.

weather_severity.description: Synthetic severity rating for weather-related claims.

wind_gust_kmh.description: Synthetic peak wind gust speed in kilometres per hour.

estimated_cost.description: Synthetic estimated claim cost in NZD.

actual_cost.description: Synthetic final cost in NZD where available for settled or rejected claims.

sla_days.description: Target service-level duration for the product.

days_open.description: Synthetic number of days the claim has been open.

days_to_settle.description: Synthetic settlement duration, populated for settled claims.

contact_count.description: Synthetic number of customer contacts recorded against the claim.

is_weather_event.description: True when the claim is correlated to the synthetic Auckland weather event.

sla_at_risk.description: Derived flag for open claims close to or beyond SLA target.

manual_intervention_required.description: Derived operational flag for complex, high-cost, non-digital, or critical claims.

digital_lodgement.description: Derived flag indicating lodgement through My Tower.

timestamp.description: Event timestamp used by Real-Time Dashboard KQL queries.

demo_notice.description: Explicit notice that the payload is synthetic demo data only.
